course_name_original: Organization and Management of a Company (3352)
course_name_en: Organization and Management of a Company

learning_outcomes.text: Teach the basics in organizing and managing the activities in a modern company.
Facilitate using managerial skills in practice.

syllabus_topics: Development of the science for managing a company
Marketing as part of company’s activities
Organizational and legal aspects of a company
assessment_rules: The final grade is a result of a written exam. Students receive three identical questions for the written exam. Alternatively, students can choose to take three tests during the semester. The final mark for the tests is an average of the three tests.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
